title: Choose the app environment
responsibility: Connect the native mobile or desktop adapter when available, otherwise select the web environment.

inputs.name: selectEnvironment.host
inputs.description: The runtime host inspected to choose an adapter. Native Capacitor detection takes precedence; otherwise only a truthy harness selects Electron, and harnessRemote alone does not select it.

outputs.name: selectEnvironment
outputs.description: Returns the Capacitor adapter result when the optional native check returns true, otherwise the Electron adapter result when harness is truthy, otherwise the web value with kind web, bridge undefined and local false. Capacitor detection has priority, and web selection provides no bridge.
